en.explanation:
Let, P(x) = ax2 + bx + c

As, P(0) = 1,

a(0)2 + b(0) + c = 1

c = 1

P(x) = ax2 + bx + 1

If   P(x) is divided by x 1, remainder = 4

P

a + b + 1 = 4 . . . . . (1)

If    P(x) is divided by x + 1, remainder = 6

P( 1) = 6

a b + 1 = 6 . . . .(2)

By solving (1) and (2) we get,

a = 4, and b = 1

P(x) = 4x2 x + 1

P(2) = 4(2)2 2 + 1 = 15
